description: Model-free replay of E7c and E7o: each run repeats, without calling any API, the recorded tool calls of an original run (same model, same K, same seed, and hence the same plan), in the same order, with the same arguments and labels, and at the same relative instant. src chooses the recording from the first (0) or second (1) original boot. Shows that the E7c/E7o outcome can be reproduced without the commercial models, which may change or cease to exist.
